blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Some things we do every day. Other things, we do only once a week.

In English, we use frequency adverbs: always, usually, often, sometimes, never. They help us describe our week clearly. For example: "I always arrive at 9am" or "I sometimes work from home."

Today you will learn 5 important words. We go step by step. You can do it!

items.q: What is the text about?
items.why: O texto fala sobre frequency adverbs: always, usually, often, sometimes, never.

items.q: Which words are frequency adverbs in the text?
items.why: "we use frequency adverbs: always, usually, often, sometimes, never."

items.q: Why do we use frequency adverbs?
items.why: "They help us describe our week clearly."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: learning English can be simple and step by step
items.why: Inferência: "We go step by step. You can do it!" — o tom é positivo e encorajador.

items.q: "I sometimes work from home" suggests that the person…
options: works from home now and then, not every day
items.why: Inferência: "sometimes" = às vezes, ou seja, em alguns dias, não todos.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falar sobre a rotina da semana dela. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I'm Sophie. Let me tell you about my week.

I always start work at nine in the morning. On Mondays, I usually have a team meeting. I like Mondays because we plan the week together. Everyone is friendly and kind.

I often work in the office, but I sometimes work from home. When I work from home, I feel calm and quiet. I never miss my morning coffee!

On Wednesdays, I usually have lunch with my friend Tom. We always talk about our projects and our plans. Tom is never late. He is always on time, and I really like that.

Fridays are my favourite day. I often finish early, and my team sometimes celebrates a good week together. We are very happy when we reach our goals. After work, I usually meet my family for dinner.

On the weekend, I never check my email. I always take a real break, and I sometimes read a good book in the park.

My week is busy, but I really like my routine. Every week is a little different, and that is good for me. I feel lucky!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time does Sophie always start work?
items.why: "I always start work at nine in the morning."

items.q: What does Sophie usually do on Mondays?
options: She stays at home all day
items.why: "On Mondays, I usually have a team meeting."

items.q: What can we say about Tom?
items.why: Inferência: "Tom is never late. He is always on time" — ele é pontual e confiável.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about her routine?
options: She likes it, even though her week is busy
items.why: Inferência: "My week is busy, but I really like my routine… I feel lucky!"

items.q: Why does Sophie like Mondays?
options: Because the team plans the week together
Because she has lunch with Tom
items.why: "I like Mondays because we plan the week together."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I always arrive at 9am." Always means…
items.why: Always = sempre, todas as vezes.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "She ___ has lunch at one o'clock, but today she ate at two."
items.why: Usually = geralmente: quase sempre, mas hoje foi diferente.

items.q: "We often celebrate wins." Often means…
items.why: Often = frequentemente, muitas vezes.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "They ___ travel to Brazil — maybe two times a year."
items.why: Sometimes = às vezes: em algumas ocasiões, não sempre.

items.q: "I never skip the morning meeting." Never means…
items.why: Never = nunca, nenhuma vez.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples do dia a dia no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "On Fridays I sometimes work from home." To work from home means to…
options: do your job at home, not at the office
items.why: Work from home = trabalhar de casa (home office).

items.q: "Tom is never late. He is always on time." On time means…
options: at the right moment, not late
items.why: On time = na hora, pontual.

items.q: "I have a day off on Monday, so I will rest." A day off is…
options: the first day of the job
items.why: Day off = dia de folga, sem trabalho.

items.q: "Let's catch up on Friday and talk about the week." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar o papo/assunto em dia, atualizar-se.

items.q: "We usually wrap up the week on Friday afternoon." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = finalizar, encerrar.
